name: topcv
description: Dynamic form builder with Next.js CSR frontend and NestJS backend.

scripts.services:up: docker compose up -d mongodb redis elasticsearch
scripts.test: pnpm test:shared && pnpm --filter be test && pnpm --filter my-app test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @topcv/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter be typecheck && pnpm --filter my-app typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter my-app lint && pnpm --filter be lint
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.check: pnpm verify && pnpm --filter be build && pnpm --filter my-app build
